title: Validate Successful LTE Attach and Detach for Single UE in Excellent Radio Conditions
preconditions: Single LTE cell is active and unloaded; all other cells are powered off
UE is stationary and placed under excellent LTE radio conditions (RSRP as per Clause 4.6)
Test configuration parameters are recorded
testSteps: Start call flow and signalling message logging
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure
Wait for attach complete confirmation
Verify UE is attached to the correct LTE cell (check PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach procedure
Wait for detach accept confirmation
Stop and save logs
Repeat the above steps 10 times
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% for 10 iterations
Detach success rate is 100% for 10 iterations
Attach latency is measured and recorded (min, average, max)
Signalling connection release verified via UE context release and RRC connection release messages
verificationMethods: Analysis of UE logs for attach/detach messages
Validation of call flow and signalling messages in logs

title: Validate Successful 5G NSA Attach and Detach Including Secondary Node Addition and Release for Single UE
preconditions: Single 5G NSA cell (LTE + NR) is active and unloaded; all other cells powered off
UE is stationary and placed under excellent 5G SS-RSRP radio conditions (Clause 4.6)
Test configuration parameters including PCI, Global eNB ID/gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN are recorded
testSteps: Start call flow and signalling message logging
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure
Wait for attach complete and secondary node addition complete confirmations
Verify UE is attached to correct LTE and NR cells
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach and 5G Secondary Node release
Wait for detach accept and secondary node release confirmations
Stop and save logs
Repeat the above steps 10 times
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% for 10 iterations
Secondary Node Addition success rate is 100% for 10 iterations
Detach success rate including secondary node release is 100% for 10 iterations
Signalling connection release verified via UE context release and RRC connection release messages
Secondary Node resources successfully released as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1
verificationMethods: UE logs validation of attach and secondary node addition messages
Call flow analysis for detach and secondary node release message sequences
Measurement and recording of KPIs in tables 5-2 and 5-3

title: Verify Attach Failure Behavior when UE is Placed Outside Excellent Radio Conditions
preconditions: Single cell active and unloaded
UE placed in poor or borderline radio conditions exceeding minimum coupling loss
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Start logging of call flow and signalling messages
Power ON UE to initiate attach
Observe attach procedure attempt
Power OFF UE if attach fails or after timeout
Stop logging and save logs
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails or times out
Attach success rate less than 100%
Logs show error or timeout messages in attach procedure
System gracefully handles attach failure without crashes
verificationMethods: Analysis of failure messages in UE and network logs
Validation that system does not accept attach under poor radio conditions

title: Validate Detach Failure Handling when UE Power OFF is Unavailable
preconditions: Single cell active with UE attached
UE cannot be powered OFF due to hardware/software failure
Logging enabled
testSteps: Attempt to initiate detach by powering OFF UE
If UE power OFF fails, trigger alternative detach initiation if supported (e.g., network-initiated detach)
Observe signalling messages for detach procedure
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Detach procedure completes successfully via alternative method or times out gracefully
Detach success rate is affected accordingly
System logs indicate failure to power OFF UE and steps taken
verificationMethods: Review of signalling flows for detach initiation

title: Validate Attach and Detach Procedures at Boundary Radio Conditions (Just at Minimum Coupling Loss)
preconditions: Single cell active and unloaded
UE placed at radio condition threshold defined by minimum coupling loss (Clause 4.6)
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Start logging
Power ON UE to trigger attach
Wait for attach complete or failure
Power OFF UE to trigger detach
Wait for detach accept
Stop and save logs
Repeat 10 times
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates close to 100%, may include some failures due to borderline conditions
Latency and KPIs recorded and compared against expected thresholds
System maintains stable operation under edge radio conditions
verificationMethods: Analysis of KPIs and success rates
Attach and detach message flow analysis

title: Validate Secondary Node Release Procedure when SN Rejects Release Request
preconditions: 5G NSA cell active with UE attached
Secondary Node configured to reject SN Release due to SN change procedure
Logging enabled
testSteps: Initiate MN-initiated SN Release by sending SgNB Release Request
Observe SN response for SgNB Release Request Acknowledge or rejection
Verify system behavior upon rejection
Complete cleanup as per protocol
Save logs
expectedResults: SN rejects release request correctly
MN handles rejection as per specification, cancelling relevant CPC or CPAC if applicable
No resource leaks or inconsistent states after rejection
Logs show correct signalling message sequences
verificationMethods: Review of signalling messages for SN Release procedure

title: Measure Attach and Detach Latency Under Excellent Radio Conditions for 10 Iterations
preconditions: Single cell active and unloaded
UE under excellent radio conditions
Logging enabled
testSteps: Repeat the attach and detach procedure (power ON and power OFF UE) 10 times
Capture timestamps for attach request and attach complete events
Calculate latency for each iteration
Record min, average, and max latency values in Table 5-3
expectedResults: Attach latency values within expected target KPIs
Consistent latency observed across all iterations
Attach and detach success rate 100%
verificationMethods: Calculation and validation of latency KPIs

title: Evaluate Attach and Detach Success Rate Under Varying Load Conditions
preconditions: Single cell active with multiple UEs (though test is for single UE, simulate load on cell)
UE under excellent radio conditions
testSteps: Configure cell with background load (other UEs active)
Perform attach and detach procedure for the test UE 10 times
Capture attach and detach success rates and latency
Compare with baseline under unloaded conditions
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates maintained close to 100%
Latency within acceptable ranges
System handles load without degradation affecting single UE attach/detach
verificationMethods: Comparison of KPIs under load vs unloaded conditions
Log analysis for failures or delays

title: Verify Authentication and Authorization During Attach Procedures
preconditions: Single cell active
UE with valid credentials
Logging enabled
testSteps: Power ON UE to initiate attach
Monitor authentication procedure messages
Verify authorization granted before attach complete
Attempt attach with invalid credentials and observe rejection
expectedResults: Attach succeeds only with valid credentials
Invalid credentials cause attach failure with appropriate error messages
No unauthorized access granted
Logs show correct authentication message sequences
verificationMethods: Analysis of authentication messages in logs
Validation of attach success/failure based on credentials

title: Integration Test of UE Attach-Detach with End-to-End O-RAN C-Plane and Secondary Node Release
preconditions: End-to-end setup operational for LTE or 5G NSA
Single cell active and unloaded
UE under excellent radio conditions
testSteps: Power ON UE to attach to network
Verify signaling and data plane integration between O-RAN components and UE
Power OFF UE to detach and trigger secondary node release (for 5G NSA)
Verify signaling flows across MN, SN, and UE
Capture and analyze logs for end-to-end consistency
expectedResults: Successful attach and detach with correct signaling across components
Secondary node release procedure completes without residual resource allocations
No loss of data or signaling anomalies
Logs confirm proper message sequences and coordination

title: Verify Clarity and Simplicity of Test Procedure Steps for Operator Execution
preconditions: Test procedure documentation available
Operator trained on test execution
testSteps: Operator follows test procedure step-by-step for attach-detach test
Record time and errors encountered in executing each step
Collect operator feedback on clarity and ease of understanding
expectedResults: Test steps are executed without confusion or misinterpretation
Minimal errors caused by ambiguity in instructions
Operator feedback indicates high usability

title: Validate Test Procedure Compatibility Across Lab and Field Environments
preconditions: Lab environment with variable attenuator/fading generator setup
Field environment with radiated eNB/gNB antennas
Single cell active and unloaded
testSteps: Execute attach-detach test procedure in lab environment
Execute attach-detach test procedure in field environment
Compare KPIs including attach/detach success rates and latency
Record any environmental differences impacting test results
expectedResults: Test procedure is executable and yields valid results in both environments
KPIs meet expected thresholds in both environments under excellent radio conditions
Differences in KPIs attributable to environment are documented
verificationMethods: Comparison of KPIs from lab and field tests
Review of environmental parameter settings and conditions

title: Validate Coordination Between MN and SN During MN Initiated Secondary Node Release
preconditions: 5G NSA cell active with UE attached
MN and SN configured for inter-node communication
Logging enabled
testSteps: MN initiates SN Release by sending SgNB Release Request
Observe SN response with SgNB Release Request Acknowledge or rejection
Verify MN cancels CPC or CPAC configurations if applicable
MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration to UE for SCG release
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages
Verify proper resource release upon UE Context Release
expectedResults: Smooth coordination between MN and SN with correct message exchanges
Proper cancellation of CPC/CPAC configurations
UE releases SCG configuration as expected
SN resources released properly without data loss
verificationMethods: Signalling flow analysis between MN and SN

title: Validate SN Initiated Secondary Node Release and Data Forwarding Coordination
preconditions: 5G NSA cell active with UE attached
SN configured to initiate release
Logging enabled
testSteps: SN initiates release by sending SgNB Release Required message
MN responds with SgNB Release Confirm providing data forwarding addresses if applicable
Observe SN starting data forwarding and stopping user data delivery to UE
MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration to UE for SCG release
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages
Verify resource release upon UE Context Release
expectedResults: SN correctly initiates release and coordinates with MN
Data forwarding initiated smoothly minimizing service gaps
UE releases SCG configuration properly
Resources released without service interruption

title: Test Security Behavior During Secondary Node Release Procedure
preconditions: 5G NSA cell active with UE attached
Security policies applied on MN and SN nodes
testSteps: Attempt Secondary Node Release from MN and SN sides
Verify authorization checks before accepting release requests
Monitor for any unauthorized release attempts
Check for secure handling of data forwarding addresses and status reports
expectedResults: Only authorized release requests are accepted
Unauthorized requests are rejected with proper error handling
Sensitive data in release messages is protected
Logs show secure and authenticated message exchanges

title: Validate Handling of RRCConnectionReconfiguration Failure During Secondary Node Release
preconditions: 5G NSA cell active with UE attached
UE configured to simulate inability to comply with RRCConnectionReconfiguration message
testSteps: Initiate Secondary Node Release procedure (MN or SN initiated)
MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE instructing SCG release
UE simulates reconfiguration failure
Observe system behavior and recovery procedures
expectedResults: UE performs reconfiguration failure procedures as per specification
System handles failure gracefully without resource leaks
Logs show failure and recovery message flows
verificationMethods: Call flow analysis for failure handling
